connector.name: Zxoar
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first trading on the ZXOAR launchpad (Uniswap V4): scan, vet, guarded buy/sell, atomic launch
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package zxoar-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace fi.zxoar, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional trading key — without it the server is READ-ONLY (scan/vet/info only). Signs locally; never leaves your machine.

env.name: MAX_ETH_PER_TX
env.description: Server-enforced cap per trade in ETH (default 0.5).

env.name: MAX_ETH_PER_SESSION
env.description: Server-enforced cumulative session spend cap in ETH (default 2).

env.name: MAX_TX_PER_MINUTE
env.description: Server-enforced rate limit on state-changing calls (default 12).

env.name: RPC_URL
env.description: Override the chain RPC (defaults to Robinhood Chain mainnet; pair with CHAIN_ID and the *_ADDRESS vars for forks/testnets).
